readback.completionPolicy: bounded latest results; count evictions; monotonically publish latest frame

gtaoDiagnosticDelivery.semantics: Deferred mapping is requested by the producer; lossless diagnostic drains occur outside the recorded callback/queue span. Each retained row has original frame/epoch attribution.

timingSemantics.commandGpuMs: sum of explicitly bracketed command-buffer submissions made through performanceTimingScope.submit(); each start/work/end sequence is submitted atomically to the queue and excludes host gaps between submit calls
timingSemantics.gpuMs: legacy alias of queueSpanGpuMs; retained for report compatibility
timingSemantics.hostWaitMs: explicit host-side waits recorded through performanceTimingScope.recordHostWait()/measureHostWait(); never a GPU-time substitute
timingSemantics.queueSpanGpuMs: GPU timestamp span from a marker submitted before the async pass callback until a marker submitted after it returns; includes queued GPU work and may include GPU-idle time caused by host waits before the ending marker is submitted
timingSemantics.readbackMapLatencyMs: wall-clock latency of SM-500 timestamp readback mapAsync; diagnostic transport latency, not GPU execution time

composition.policy: SM-307 strongest-occluder/min semantics; Material AO and GTAO are not multiplied
